props.label: About Us
props.heading: Premium car detailing in Nagpur
props.body:
Detailing Daddy is a professional car detailing studio in Nagpur, specialising in ceramic coating, paint protection film, paint correction, and exterior and interior detailing.

We combine professional techniques, quality products and attention to detail to enhance your car’s appearance and provide long-lasting protection.

That means the preparation gets the time it deserves. Paint is washed, decontaminated and corrected before anything is applied, because a coating locks in whatever is underneath it. We will tell you what the paint actually needs, what each level of work will and will not fix, and the price — before anything starts.

Detailing Daddy — Precision. Protection. Perfection.

props.label: Our Services
props.heading: What we do
props.sub: Seven services, from a safe foam wash through to full paint correction and ceramic coating.

items.title: Ceramic Coating
items.desc: A hard, hydrophobic layer bonded to your paint — deeper gloss, easier washing, and real protection against UV, dirt and water spotting.
items.meta: Gloss and protection that lasts years
items.body:
Ceramic coating is a liquid polymer that bonds chemically with the factory clear coat and cures into a hard, glass-like layer. It is not a wax and it does not wash off after a few weeks.

What it changes day to day: water beads and rolls off instead of sitting on the panel, so the car dries with fewer marks. Dust and road grime do not key into the surface the same way, so washing takes less effort and less scrubbing — which is itself what causes most swirl marks. The gloss is deeper because the coating levels the surface optically.

The result depends almost entirely on what goes underneath. Paint is washed, decontaminated and corrected first, because a coating locks in whatever is there — including swirls. That preparation is most of the work and most of the time.

items.title: Paint Protection Film (PPF)
items.desc: A clear urethane film applied over the panels, taking stone chips and scratches so the paint underneath does not.
items.meta: A physical shield over the paint
items.body:
PPF is a thick, self-healing urethane film laid over the paint. Where a coating changes how the surface behaves, film puts a physical barrier in the way — it is the difference between water beading off and a stone chip not reaching your paint at all.

Most owners start with the high-impact areas: bonnet, front bumper, front sections of the wings, wing mirrors and the headlights. Full-body is available where the car justifies it. Light swirls in the film itself heal with heat.

Fitting is slow and precise work — the film is wrapped around panel edges rather than cut on the paint. Done properly it is close to invisible, and it comes off years later without taking the paint with it.

items.title: Interior & Exterior Detailing
items.desc: Full interior deep clean and exterior decontamination, polish and protection — the reset a car needs once or twice a year.
items.body:
Detailing is not a wash. Outside, the car is decontaminated — iron fallout, tar and bonded contaminants that a normal wash leaves behind — then machine polished to remove swirls and hazing, then protected.

Inside, seats, carpets and mats are extracted rather than wiped, vents and crevices are cleaned out, leather is cleaned and conditioned, plastics and trim are dressed without leaving them greasy, and the glass is finished last so it stays clear.

It is the single most noticeable thing you can do to a car you already own, and it makes a real difference to resale.

items.title: Window Films
items.desc: Quality window film that cuts heat and glare inside the cabin, with the shade and finish you choose.
items.body:
A good window film is about heat rejection, not just how dark it looks. Nagpur summers put a lot of load on the cabin and on the air conditioning; the right film cuts the infrared coming through the glass, so the car cools faster and stays cooler.

It also cuts glare on the drive, protects the dashboard and upholstery from fading, and adds privacy. Films differ widely — we will explain what a given film actually rejects rather than only how dark it is.

Please note that shade limits are set by law and we fit within them.

items.title: Car Detailing Services
items.desc: A range of detailing packages — pick by what the car needs, not by a fixed menu.
items.meta: From a maintenance wash to full correction
items.body:
Cars arrive in different states, so the work is scoped to the car rather than sold as one package. A well-kept car may need a maintenance detail; a car that has been through years of automatic washes may need multi-stage paint correction before any protection goes on.

We will look at the paint, tell you what is actually wrong with it, and explain what each level of work will and will not fix. You get the price before anything starts.

items.title: Car Accessories
items.desc: Seat covers, mats, lighting, audio, visors and more — supplied and fitted in the studio.
items.body:
We stock and fit the accessories owners actually ask for: seat covers, floor mats and lamination, steering covers, armrests, door visors, LED and projector headlights, audio systems and speakers, car covers, wiper blades and cabin fragrances.

Fitting matters as much as the part. An accessory fitted badly rattles, marks the trim, or works loose — so it is done here rather than handed over in a box.

items.title: Car & Bike Foam Washing
items.desc: Snow-foam pre-wash and a two-bucket method that lifts dirt off instead of dragging it across the paint.
items.body:
Most swirl marks in Indian cars come from washing, not from driving. Dry dust dragged across a panel by a cloth behaves like sandpaper.

A foam wash starts by covering the car in thick snow foam and letting it dwell, so the grit is lifted and rinsed away before anything touches the paint. Only then is the car washed by hand, with clean mitts and separate rinse water, and dried with proper drying towels rather than whatever is nearby.

Bikes are welcome too.

items.q: How long does a ceramic coating last?
items.a: It depends on the coating and, more importantly, on how the car is washed afterwards. Washed correctly and kept out of automatic brush washes, a quality coating stays effective for years. We will tell you what to expect from the specific coating before you commit.

items.q: Is coating the same as PPF?
items.a: No. A coating changes how the surface behaves — gloss, beading, easier cleaning. PPF is a physical film that stops stone chips reaching the paint. They solve different problems and are often used together, film on the front end and coating over the rest.

items.q: How long will my car be with you?
items.a: It depends on the work. A foam wash is the same day; detailing and correction usually need a full day or more, because preparation is most of the job. We will give you a realistic time when we look at the car, not an optimistic one.

items.q: Do you work on bikes as well?
items.a: Yes. Foam washing and detailing are available for bikes.

Not every one. Swirl marks and light scratches sit in the clear coat and can be polished out. Anything that has gone through the clear coat needs paint. We will show you which is which rather than polishing at something that will not come out.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Send us a WhatsApp on +91 70660 77667 with a couple of photos of the car, or bring it in. Price depends on the size of the car and the condition of the paint, so we quote after seeing it — and always before starting.

props.heading: Straight answers about car care
props.sub: What detailing actually does, what protects paint, and what is worth paying for — written for owners, not for the trade.

props.label: Blog
props.heading: Car care guides
props.sub: Six guides on protecting and maintaining your car’s finish.

posts.title: Why Regular Car Detailing Matters
posts.excerpt: Detailing is maintenance, not decoration — and it shows up in what the car is worth.
posts.body:
Most owners think of detailing as something you do before selling a car. It is closer to servicing: something that protects value continuously rather than rescuing it at the end.

Paint is a consumable. UV, bird droppings, tree sap, industrial fallout and road salt all attack the clear coat, and once it fails there is no polishing it back — it has to be resprayed. Regular decontamination and protection is the difference between a clear coat that lasts the life of the car and one that clouds in five years.

Inside, the damage is slower but just as real: sunlight fades and cracks dashboards, grit ground into carpets wears the fibres, and spills that sit become permanent.

The practical rhythm for most cars is a proper detail once or twice a year, with correct washing in between. That is enough to keep a car looking close to new.

posts.title: Ceramic Coating — Benefits, Protection & Maintenance
posts.excerpt: What a coating does, what it does not, and how to look after one.
posts.body:
A ceramic coating bonds to the clear coat and cures into a hard, hydrophobic layer. The visible benefits are gloss and beading; the real one is that dirt keys into the surface less, so washing is gentler and washing is where most damage happens.

What it does not do is make the car scratch-proof. A coating resists light marring and chemical etching; it will not stop a stone chip or a key. For that you need film.

Maintenance is simple but not optional. Wash with a pH-neutral shampoo, avoid automatic brush washes entirely, do not let bird droppings sit, and dry with a clean towel. Done that way a good coating stays effective for years.

Preparation decides the outcome. A coating applied over swirled paint locks the swirls in, so correction comes first — and that is most of the work.

posts.title: Paint Correction — Restore Your Car’s Original Shine
posts.excerpt: What those swirl marks actually are, and what it takes to remove them.
posts.body:
Hold a torch to a dark car and you will see fine circular scratches across the panel. Those are swirl marks, and they are not in the paint — they are in the clear coat on top of it. They scatter light, which is why the car looks dull even when clean.

Paint correction removes them by levelling a few microns of clear coat with a machine polisher and abrasive compounds. Done in stages: a cutting stage to remove the defects, then a refining stage to remove the haze the cutting leaves.

It is not something to repeat endlessly. Clear coat is finite, and every correction takes a little. That is exactly why protecting the finish afterwards, and washing correctly, matters — so the car never needs heavy correction again.

Not every defect is correctable. Anything through the clear coat needs paint, and we will tell you that rather than polishing at it.

posts.title: Interior Detailing — Deep Cleaning & Cabin Care
posts.excerpt: Where the dirt actually is, and why wiping it does not work.
posts.body:
A cabin looks clean long after it stops being clean. Most of what is in a car is in the carpet pile, the seat foam and the vents, and a wipe over the plastics does not touch any of it.

A proper interior detail extracts rather than wipes: hot water and solution injected into fabric and pulled back out with the soil in it. Vents and switch surrounds are cleaned out, leather is cleaned then conditioned so it does not dry and crack, plastics are dressed to a matte finish rather than left shiny and greasy, and the glass is done last so it ends up genuinely clear.

It makes the biggest difference in cars that carry children, pets or food — and it is the part owners notice most, because it is where they sit.

posts.title: How to Protect Your Car’s Paint & Maintain Its Gloss
posts.excerpt: Six habits that matter more than any product you can buy.
posts.body:
Wash correctly. Two buckets, one for soap and one to rinse the mitt, a pH-neutral shampoo, and never a circular motion — straight lines, front to back.

Never use an automatic brush wash. The brushes carry grit from every car before yours, and they are the single fastest way to swirl a finish.

Deal with contamination immediately. Bird droppings and tree sap are acidic and will etch through clear coat in days in Nagpur heat. Keep a detail spray and a clean cloth in the car.

Dry properly. Letting a car air-dry leaves mineral spots that then need polishing off. Use a large plush drying towel.

Park in shade where you can. UV is what dulls paint and fades trim.

Protect the surface — wax, sealant or a coating. What matters is that something sits between the clear coat and the world.

posts.title: Paint Protection Film (PPF) — Ultimate Paint Protection
posts.excerpt: When film is worth it, and where to put it.
posts.body:
A ceramic coating changes how the surface behaves. PPF puts a physical barrier in the way. They solve different problems, and on a car that is driven hard they work well together — film on the impact zones, coating over the top.

Film earns its cost on highway miles. Stone chips on the bonnet and front bumper are the most common paint damage on any car in regular use, and they are the one thing no coating prevents.

Most owners fit a front kit: bonnet, front bumper, leading edges of the wings, mirrors and headlights. Full-body makes sense on a car worth protecting completely.

Quality varies enormously. Good film is self-healing, does not yellow, and comes off cleanly years later. Cheap film yellows, cracks and takes paint with it — which costs far more than the film saved.
